name: WireGuard Easy
description: Simple web UI for managing a WireGuard VPN server with one-click client configuration.

env.label: Server Public IP/Hostname
env.description: Public IP address or hostname clients will connect to

env.label: Admin Password Hash
env.description: Bcrypt password hash for the web UI (generate with: htpasswd -nbBC 10 '' 'yourpassword' | cut -d: -f2)

env.label: WireGuard Listen Port
env.description: UDP port WireGuard listens on for VPN connections

env.label: Client DNS Server
env.description: DNS server assigned to VPN clients (e.g., 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, or your Pi-hole IP)

env.label: Client Address Range
env.description: IP address range for VPN clients (x is replaced with client number)

env.label: Allowed IPs
env.description: Allowed IP ranges for client traffic (0.0.0.0/0 routes all traffic through VPN)

env.label: Persistent Keepalive
env.description: Keepalive interval in seconds (25 recommended for NAT traversal, 0 to disable)

env.label: UI Language
env.description: Web UI language code (e.g., en, de, fr, zh-tw)
